sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT rel_outlet_sku.outlet_id)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id), 0) AS 铺市率
FROM dim_outlet o
LEFT JOIN rel_outlet_sku ON o.outlet_id = rel_outlet_sku.outlet_id
WHERE o.region = '华南'
  AND o.is_active = TRUE

SELECT
  o.outlet_name AS 终端名称,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.is_executed)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.is_planned), 0) AS 拜访达成率,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.has_order)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.is_executed), 0) AS 拜访成单率
FROM fact_visit fv
JOIN dim_date d ON fv.date_key = d.date_key
JOIN dim_outlet o ON fv.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
WHERE o.channel = '便利店'
  AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY o.outlet_name

SELECT year_month AS 月份
FROM dim_date
WHERE full_date = DATE '2026-08-01'

SELECT
  dl.dealer_name AS 经销商名称,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.has_order)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.is_executed), 0) AS 拜访成单率
FROM fact_visit fv
JOIN dim_date d ON fv.date_key = d.date_key
JOIN dim_outlet o ON fv.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
JOIN dim_dealer dl ON o.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
WHERE dl.region = '华北'
  AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY dl.dealer_name

WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region AS 大区,
        SUM(s.qty) AS 总销量
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 大区
FROM region_sales
ORDER BY 总销量 DESC
LIMIT 1

  AND o.channel = '这个渠道'

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY d.year_month
),
monthly_promo AS (
    SELECT
        d.year_month,
        SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost_amount
    FROM fact_promo_cost pc
    JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY d.year_month
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ms.year_month, mp.year_month) AS year_month,
        ms.net_amount,
        mp.cost_amount
    FROM monthly_sales ms
    FULL OUTER JOIN monthly_promo mp ON ms.year_month = mp.year_month
)
SELECT
    SUM(cost_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE net_amount IS NOT NULL), 0) AS 促销费用率
FROM combined

sql:
SELECT o.region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id) AS 有效终端数
FROM dim_outlet o
WHERE o.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY o.region

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_new_product THEN r.outlet_id END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id), 0) AS 新品铺市率
FROM dim_outlet o
JOIN dim_dealer dl ON o.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
LEFT JOIN rel_outlet_sku r ON o.outlet_id = r.outlet_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON r.sku_id = p.sku_id
WHERE dl.region = '华东'
  AND o.is_active = TRUE

SELECT
  o.region AS 大区,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_new_product THEN ros.outlet_id END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id), 0) AS 新品铺市率
FROM rel_outlet_sku ros
JOIN dim_outlet o ON ros.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
JOIN dim_product p ON ros.sku_id = p.sku_id
WHERE o.region IN ('华东', '华南')
GROUP BY o.region

WITH inv AS (
  SELECT
    fi.dealer_id,
    d.year_month,
    SUM(fi.qty_on_hand) AS qty_on_hand
  FROM fact_inventory fi
  JOIN dim_date d ON fi.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date >= DATE '2024-09-01'
    AND d.full_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY fi.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
sales AS (
  SELECT
    fs.dealer_id,
    d.year_month,
    SUM(fs.qty) AS qty,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.date_key) AS days
  FROM fact_sales fs
  JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date >= DATE '2024-09-01'
    AND d.full_date <= DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY fs.dealer_id, d.year_month
)
SELECT
  dl.dealer_name AS 经销商名称,
  SUM(inv.qty_on_hand) / NULLIF(SUM(sales.qty) / NULLIF(SUM(sales.days), 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM inv
JOIN dim_dealer dl ON inv.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
LEFT JOIN sales ON inv.dealer_id = sales.dealer_id AND inv.year_month = sales.year_month
WHERE dl.region = '华北'
GROUP BY dl.dealer_name

SELECT SUM(s.qty) AS 销量
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'

WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo = TRUE
    AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY 1
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT SUM(s.amt) / NULLIF(SUM(c.cost), 0) AS 费效比
FROM s
JOIN c USING (year_month)

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_new_product THEN r.outlet_id END)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.outlet_id), 0) AS 新品铺市率
FROM dim_outlet o
LEFT JOIN rel_outlet_sku r ON o.outlet_id = r.outlet_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON r.sku_id = p.sku_id
WHERE o.region = '华东'
  AND o.is_active = TRUE

SELECT o.outlet_name AS 终端名称
FROM fact_visit fv
JOIN dim_date d ON fv.date_key = d.date_key
JOIN dim_outlet o ON fv.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY o.outlet_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.is_executed)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fv.is_planned), 0) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  o.outlet_name AS 终端名称,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS 净销额
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
WHERE o.channel = '连锁超市'
  AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY o.outlet_name
